issues.problem: The flag treats the marks as stray and suggests 'aśīya', but the Devanagari reads 'अशीयाऽऽ विवासेयं': the long ā and avagraha-type signs record the contraction aśīya + ā (the next word begins ā-vivāseyam or the ā is a separate particle). Deleting them would drop a printed vowel, and the split/translation do not account for any ā.
issues.fix: Keep the flag as 'unusual contraction aśīyā-ऽ, probably aśīya ā; sense of ā unclear', not a plain deletion; mention in notes that ā is untranslated.

issues.where: Like one in the heat reaching shade, free from fault may I attain it
issues.problem: The English (and Hindi) supply 'one in', 'reaching' and an object 'it'; the line has only ghṛṇiḥ iva chāyām (heat ... shade) arapāḥ aśīya. The notes claim 'only what the grammar needs' is supplied, which is not so.
issues.fix: Keep to the text: 'Like heat (seeking) shade, free from fault may I attain' is still a supply; move 'one in', 'reaching' and 'it' to the notes and leave the object of aśīya open.

summary: Reviewed 15 units of RV 2.33. Total issues: 3 error, 28 minor. Errors: unit 8 Hindi doubles/mismatches maho and adds 'रूप वाले' (and gram 'dat.' for mahaḥ is impossible); unit 11 Hindi inserts the name 'रुद्र' into a line that does not name him; unit 12 uses 1 sg. nānāma for both 'I' and the boy and invents 'as ... as'. Minor: footnote-like flags on '१' in units 2 and 7 are wrong (it is the svarita sign); unit 6 flag on aśīyā'' wrongly suggests deleting a printed ā, and the English adds 'one in', 'reaching', 'it'; vajra and maghavan and the refrain deviate from the glossary (units 3, 14, 15); śaṃtama 'सुखकर' (units 2, 13); additions in Hindi ('के हाथ', 'आभूषणों', 'कभी'); daivya 'divine' (unit 7); neuter gram of sthirebhiḥ/śukrebhiḥ (unit 9). Units 4 and 10 are ok. Confidences honest. No regrouping suggested.
